entries.title: A secret concealed inside an ordinary action
entries.odia: ବୁଡ଼ି କରି ପାଣି ପିଇଲେ ମହାଦେବଙ୍କ ବାପା ମଧ୍ୟ ଜାଣି ପରିବେ ନାହିଁ
entries.literal_meaning: If someone drinks water while submerged, even Mahadev’s father will not know.
entries.explanation: The dictionary places this example under doing something secretly. Drinking is hidden within the larger act of being underwater, so an observer cannot easily separate one from the other. The extravagant appeal to Mahadev’s father makes the claim of secrecy comic. It can describe someone’s confidence that a concealed action will escape notice; it does not establish that deception always succeeds.
entries.meaning_odia: ପାଣି ଭିତରେ ବୁଡ଼ିଥିବା ଲୋକ ପାଣି ପିଇଲେ, ବାହାରୁ ଦେଖୁଥିବା ଲୋକକୁ ସେ କାମଟି ଅଲଗା କରି ଜଣାପଡ଼େ ନାହିଁ। ଅଭିଧାନ ଏହାକୁ ଗୋପନରେ କାମ କରିବାର ଉଦାହରଣ ଭାବେ ଦେଇଛି। ମହାଦେବଙ୍କ ବାପା ବି ଜାଣିପାରିବେ ନାହିଁ କହି କଥାଟି ଲୁଚାଇବାର ଦାବିକୁ ହସରେ ବଢ଼ାଇଦିଏ। ଏଥିରୁ ସବୁ ଲୁଚା କାମ ଚିରକାଳ ଅଜଣା ରହିବ ବୋଲି ନିଶ୍ଚୟ କରିହୁଏ ନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: The dictionary places this example under doing something secretly.
entries.odia_summary: ପାଣି ଭିତରେ ବୁଡ଼ିଥିବା ଲୋକ ପାଣି ପିଇଲେ, ବାହାରୁ ଦେଖୁଥିବା ଲୋକକୁ ସେ କାମଟି ଅଲଗା କରି ଜଣାପଡ଼େ ନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: While supposedly tidying a shared desk, someone quietly removes a note and assumes nobody noticed. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
entries.cultural_context: The expression is comic hyperbole, not theological genealogy or an instruction to drink underwater. Source spelling ପରିବେ is retained, not silently changed to ପାରିବେ.

entries.title: Talking oneself out of a welcome meal
entries.odia: ପୁତୁରା ସାଙ୍ଗରେ କଳି କଲି, ମହୁର ତିଅଣରୁ ମେଞ୍ଚାଏ ପାଆନ୍ତି, ତୁଣ୍ଡ ପରସାଦୁଁ ନାଶ ଗଲି
entries.literal_meaning: I quarrelled with my nephew; I might have received a generous portion of mahura curry, but my own mouth spoiled it.
entries.explanation: The speaker looks back on a quarrel and the food they might otherwise have enjoyed. The dictionary defines ମେଞ୍ଚାଏ as a large portion of food. Here the humorous self-accusation turns an abstract consequence of quarrelling into a lost meal: the mouth that wanted food also said the words that cost it. This is a close reading of the example, not a reconstructed family incident.
entries.meaning_odia: ପୁତୁରା ସହ କଳି କରିବା ପରେ କଥକ ମନେ ପକାଉଛନ୍ତି, ନକରିଥିଲେ ମହୁର ତିଅଣରୁ ଭଲ ଭାଗଟିଏ ମିଳିଥାନ୍ତା। ଯେଉଁ ତୁଣ୍ଡ ଖାଇବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଥିଲା, ସେହି ତୁଣ୍ଡର କଥା ହିଁ ଖାଇବାର ସୁଯୋଗ ନଷ୍ଟ କଲା—ଏହି ବିରୋଧରେ ହସ ଅଛି। ଅନାବଶ୍ୟକ କଳି କରି ନିଜ ସୁବିଧା ବା ସମ୍ପର୍କ ବିଗାଡ଼ିଦେବା ପରେ ଏପରି ନିଜକୁ ନେଇ କୁହାଯାଇପାରେ। ତାହା ବୋଲି ଖାଇବା ବା ସୁବିଧା ପାଇଁ ସବୁ ଅନ୍ୟାୟ ସହିବାକୁ କୁହାଯାଉନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: The speaker looks back on a quarrel and the food they might otherwise have enjoyed.
entries.odia_summary: ପୁତୁରା ସହ କଳି କରିବା ପରେ କଥକ ମନେ ପକାଉଛନ୍ତି, ନକରିଥିଲେ ମହୁର ତିଅଣରୁ ଭଲ ଭାଗଟିଏ ମିଳିଥାନ୍ତା।
entries.usage_example: After needlessly snapping at a friend, someone regrets spoiling the relaxed lunch they had planned together. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
entries.cultural_context: Mahura is retained as a named curry; no ingredients, temple recipe or historical household are inferred. The reading concerns needless quarrelling, not an obligation to remain silent about mistreatment.

entries.title: Respect that lasts only while help is needed
entries.odia: କାମ ପଡ଼ିଲେ କାଜି, କାମ ଛାଡ଼ିଲେ ପାଜି
entries.literal_meaning: When there is work to be done, a qazi; when the need is over, a scoundrel.
entries.explanation: The paired words move abruptly from a title of authority to an insult. Read together, they expose respect that depends entirely on another person’s usefulness: someone is important while needed and dismissed afterward. The target of this reading is the speaker’s opportunism, not the integrity of qazis or any religious community.
entries.meaning_odia: କାମ ପଡ଼ିଥିବା ବେଳେ ଯାହାକୁ କାଜି କହି ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦିଆଯାଉଥିଲା, କାମ ସରିଲେ ତାଙ୍କୁ ପାଜି କୁହାଯାଉଛି। ଦୁଇଟି ମିଳୁଥିବା ଶବ୍ଦରେ ଆଦରରୁ ଅପମାନକୁ ହଠାତ୍ ବଦଳିଯିବା ଧରାପଡ଼େ। ଦରକାର ବେଳେ ଆଦର କରି, ଦରକାର ସରିଲେ ମଣିଷଟିକୁ ଭୁଲିଯିବାର ସ୍ୱାର୍ଥପରତାକୁ ଏହି ପାଠରେ ଦେଖିହୁଏ। ଏହା କୌଣସି ଧର୍ମର ଲୋକଙ୍କ ଚରିତ୍ର ବିଷୟରେ ନିଷ୍କର୍ଷ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: The paired words move abruptly from a title of authority to an insult.
entries.odia_summary: କାମ ପଡ଼ିଥିବା ବେଳେ ଯାହାକୁ କାଜି କହି ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦିଆଯାଉଥିଲା, କାମ ସରିଲେ ତାଙ୍କୁ ପାଜି କୁହାଯାଉଛି।
entries.usage_example: An organiser repeatedly praises a volunteer while asking for help, then refuses even to acknowledge that help once the event ends. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
entries.cultural_context: The source defines qazi as a Muslim judge and explicitly labels the paired line ଢଗ; a separate lexical entry confirms ପାଜି is an insult. Institutional history in the old dictionary is not adopted as present-day law or status.

entries.title: A lesson that stays with you
entries.literal_meaning: You will keep washing the sack and singing praises.
entries.explanation: The praise has an ironic edge. The source explains the expression as remembering someone after receiving a hard lesson from them. The repeated work of washing the sack makes that memory linger: the consequences remain after the encounter is over. It can be a rueful comment on having been taken in, rather than sincere gratitude.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଖା ଧୋଇବା ସହିତ ଗୁଣ ଗାଇବାର କଥା ଶୁଣିଲେ ପ୍ରଶଂସା ପରି ଲାଗେ। କିନ୍ତୁ ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ ଏହା ଅନ୍ୟଠାରୁ ପାନେ ପାଇ ତାକୁ ମନେ ପକାଇବା। ଘଟଣାଟି ସରିଗଲେ ବି ତାହାର ଫଳ ଭୋଗିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ୁଛି। ସେହି ଅନୁଭବକୁ ନେଇ ଏଠାରେ ଟିକେ କଟାକ୍ଷ ଅଛି; ଏହା ସରଳ ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.usage_example: A buyer keeps repairing a supposedly excellent second-hand bicycle and ruefully remembers the seller’s promises. (Original imagined occasion, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: The source supplies the hard-lesson gloss but no story explaining why a sack is washed. The sack image and ironic praise are retained without inventing that missing story.
entries.odia_summary: ପାନେ ପାଇବା ପରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଘଟଣାର ଫଳ ଭୋଗିବା ଓ ତାହାକୁ କଟାକ୍ଷରେ ମନେ ପକାଇବା।
entries.english_summary: The trouble continues, and so does the rueful memory of who brought it about.

entries.title: Nothing left at the root
entries.literal_meaning: To wipe out at the root.
entries.explanation: This is an expression for complete destruction, not merely a setback or a surface change. The source pairs it with another expression and explicitly glosses both as destroying something entirely. The root image makes the degree of loss clear: what might have allowed it to continue has also been removed.
entries.meaning_odia: ଏଠାରେ କେବଳ ଉପରୁ କିଛି ନଷ୍ଟ ହେବାର କଥା ନୁହେଁ। ମୂଳ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସବୁ ପୋଛିଦେବାର ଛବିରେ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଧ୍ୱଂସର ଅର୍ଥ ଅଛି। ଉତ୍ସ ମଧ୍ୟ ଏହି ଅର୍ଥ ଦେଇଛି। ଆଉ କିଛି ଅବଶିଷ୍ଟ ନ ରହିବାର ତୀବ୍ରତାକୁ ଏହା ପ୍ରକାଶ କରେ।
entries.usage_example: A flood has destroyed a family’s stored seed, tools and the shed itself; a neighbour uses the expression to describe the extent of the loss. (Original imagined occasion, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: Selected as the second expression in the source’s slash-separated pair ଖୋଳ କରିବା/ମୂଳପୋଛ କରିବା. The source’s first term is retained as a related expression, not silently translated through a guessed literal sense or counted as a second entry.
entries.odia_summary: ସାମାନ୍ୟ କ୍ଷତି ନୁହେଁ, ସମୂଳେ ଧ୍ୱଂସ ହେବାର ତୀବ୍ର ଅର୍ଥ।
entries.english_summary: An emphatic expression for destruction that leaves nothing at the root.

entries.title: The tether and the horse
entries.literal_meaning: According to the stake, the horse leaps.
entries.explanation: The source applies this image to disorder under weak supervision. The horse’s movement is viewed in relation to what holds it, so the remark turns attention from the actor alone to the arrangement around them. In a wider everyday application, repeated disorder may reveal that responsibilities or boundaries have not been made clear. That wider application is editorial; the source does not supply a history of the image.
entries.meaning_odia: ଘୋଡ଼ାର ଡେଇଁବାକୁ ଏଠାରେ ଖୁଣ୍ଟ ସହିତ ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଇଛି। ଉତ୍ସ ଏହାକୁ ଦୁର୍ବଳ ଶାସନରେ ବିଶୃଙ୍ଖଳା ଘଟିବାର ଅର୍ଥରେ ବୁଝାଇଛି। କେବଳ କାମ କରୁଥିବା ଲୋକକୁ ଦୋଷ ନ ଦେଇ, ତାଙ୍କ ଚାରିପାଖର ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥାକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଦେଖିବାର ଏକ ପାଠ ଏଥିରୁ ନିଆଯାଇପାରେ। ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ କାହାର, କଣ କରିବାକୁ ହେବ—ଏସବୁ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ନଥିଲେ ଅବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା ବଢ଼ିପାରେ।
entries.usage_example: At a shared event, supplies repeatedly go missing because nobody has been assigned to track them. Someone points to the loose arrangement rather than blaming one volunteer. (Original imagined occasion, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: The weak-supervision reading comes from this source’s gloss. Other readings of strength or support are not established here. The comparison is not a recommendation for harsh discipline or a claim that people are animals.
entries.odia_summary: କାମର ଅବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା ପଛରେ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ଓ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥାର ଦୁର୍ବଳତା ମଧ୍ୟ ଥାଇପାରେ।
entries.english_summary: The source’s image directs attention to weak supervision behind disorder.
